items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: When I was workin' with Albert Ammons and Pete Johnson and Meade Lux Lewis, they done all the contract-signin'. I was just a...just the vocalist with the group.

ctx.x: Offa records that I made a long time ago. 'Course I didn't know nothin' about all that royalty stuff. When I was workin' with Albert Ammons and Pete Johnson and Meade Lux Lewis, they done all the contract-signin'. I was just a...just the vocalist with the group. So they was gettin' all the money. I...me, I was so happy to sing, I was dumb to the fact. I didn't know you could get a song copyrighted. I had a lotta songs I...that I made up myself and sung but I didn't put my name on it. They had they names on them.…
